gloss: night of the full moon; harvest moon

definitions.gloss: night of the full moon; harvest moon
definitions.explanation: The fifteenth night of the eighth month in the traditional lunar calendar, celebrated as a moon-viewing occasion. By extension, the full moon itself.

examples.japanese: {十五夜|じゅうごや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だ。
{十五夜|じゅうごや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{団子|だんご}→団子：04959_dango⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{供|そな}えて→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧⟦{月見|つきみ}→月見：13001_tsukimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: On the night of the harvest moon, we offer dango and view the moon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{十五夜|じゅうごや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歌|うた}い→歌う：00684_utau⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}めていた→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧。
examples.english: The children were gazing at the moon in the garden while singing harvest moon songs.

notes:
Literally "fifteenth night," referring to the fifteenth night of the eighth lunar month (around mid-September to early October in the modern calendar). This is the most important moon-viewing (⟦{月見|つきみ}→月見：13001_tsukimi⟧) occasion in Japan, also called ⟦{中秋|ちゅうしゅう}→中秋：27638_chuushuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名月|めいげつ}→名月：27639_meigetsu⟧ (harvest moon of mid-autumn).

Traditional customs include displaying {月見団子|つきみだんご} (moon-viewing dumplings), {薄|すすき} (pampas grass), and seasonal offerings. The image of a rabbit pounding rice cakes on the moon (⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧のうさぎ) is strongly associated with this night.
